mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO conversation (id, user_low_id, user_high_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{userLowId}, #{userHighId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_low_id, user_high_id, user_low_last_sync_message_id, user_high_last_sync_message_id, last_message_id, last_message_time, create_time, update_time FROM conversation WHERE user_low_id = #{userLowId} AND user_high_id = #{userHighId} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, user_low_id, user_high_id, user_low_last_sync_message_id, user_high_last_sync_message_id, last_message_id, last_message_time, create_time, update_time FROM conversation WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, user_low_id, user_high_id, user_low_last_sync_message_id, user_high_last_sync_message_id, last_message_id, last_message_time, create_time, update_time FROM conversation WHERE user_low_id = #{userId} OR user_high_id = #{userId} ORDER BY COALESCE(last_message_time, create_time) DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE conversation SET last_message_id = #{messageId}, last_message_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{conversationId}
